ARI Award announcement (lists the repository, the setup guide and OAuth 2.0)

attribution.note: Ground-truth side rows written once per run (never by the subject). §4-2 (Michie 2026-09-29, after Codex review of 8d905ee): the AUTOMATIC reading of a source is 'listed' or 'unknown' only. Listed = some URL token resolves cleanly to the sealed key (sourceRepoKey: the host's identity — REPO_HOSTS, for GitHub also www.github.com — and owner/repo exact; https/http/no scheme incl. //; port none or :443; anything below the repository; /., /.., %2e, backslashes and percent-encoded names unresolvable). Tokens are never trimmed; a scheme other than http/https (data:, mailto:, javascript:, urn:, …) makes the rest up to the next whitespace opaque. 'Not listed' — which blames the company or KanseiLINK — is recorded only with a valid HUMAN attestation in evidence/attestations/<marker>-<source>-<body sha256>.json for the exact body read that run (A: the raw HTTP body bytes after HTTP 200 and complete receipt; B: the sorted [path, value] string fields of the catalog item without the top-level _* keys and freshness); a changed body expires it. Row encoding: pass = listed; instrument_error 'other' = unknown; pass=false with instrument_error=null = not listed by human attestation (*_not_listed_human_attested). A = sealed_repo_vs_official_docs over A1/A2 (listed if either is listed, not listed only if both are attested); B = sealed_repo_vs_kansei_catalog (read only, the M-002 reader; only field names recorded). Pages decoded once with the vendored WHATWG decoder (entities 8.1.0). Rename detection: the GitHub API full_name must equal the sealed owner/repo and archived must be false (15 s timeout; no answer = inconsistent), otherwise the day's judgement is 未確定（計器）. The judgement is a report-layer interpretation labelled 判断（規則 v0.1）; rows attested by a human are labelled 人の確認 on the sheet.

marker.note: M-004 covers discover + understand only (connect + execute will be M-005). No contact with the vendor: the harness only asks public LLMs (one plain turn) and checks the sealed repository's existence through the public GitHub API. THE SEAL HOLDS ONLY THE OFFICIAL MCP REPOSITORY URL. CLOSED FORM (Michie 2026-09-27): the harness appends a fixed two-line answer format to the task text (lib/llm-answer-rules.mjs ANSWER_FORMAT) — REPO: <one URL or none> / AUTH: <OAuth 2.0 | Basic | API key | unknown> — and the judge reads ONLY the answer region = the last two non-empty physical lines, which must be REPO then AUTH (form checked before content; anything before them, including code quotes that look like the two lines, is never judged); the explanation is kept in transcript.jsonl as evidence and never judged. Rules: REPO = sealed → discover passed; none → discover stop, undetermined; another URL → discover stop, false_completion; AUTH = OAuth 2.0 → done; Basic/API key → understand stop, false_completion; unknown → understand stop, undetermined; a missing line, wrong order, text after the pair, an empty value, a value outside the form or several URLs → format_violation (checked before any content, so it wins over REPO content) = undetermined on the agent's side (not an instrument error). Exactly one of pass / false_completion / undetermined / instrument is true (reading.v1 oneOf + assertExclusive). The expected method (OAuth 2.0) and the wrong tokens are rule constants (AUTH_RULE), not sealed values. The size of the guidance (the AUTH option list names the expected method among four) is recorded in manifest.prompt_guidance so the reading can be discounted.

goal_prompt.ja: AgileWorks（株式会社エイトレッド）を AI エージェントから操作したい。公式の MCP サーバーの有無と所在、Web API の認証方式を特定し、根拠の URL を添えて報告せよ。
goal_prompt.en: I want to operate AgileWorks (ATLED Co., Ltd.) from an AI agent. Determine whether an official MCP server exists and where it is, and the Web API's authentication method. Report with source URLs.

preconditions: Sealed file holds the official MCP repository URL only (draft: exec-harness/draft-marker.mjs M-004)
API keys for the four providers in .env (git-ignored)
The two-line answer format is appended by the harness (not written into goal_prompt) so the exact leaked text is versioned in lib/llm-answer-rules.mjs

publication.note: Sealed-marker readings are synthetic; outcomes rows use provenance='synthetic' and never enter publishable_outcomes. No ranking, no score, no vendor comparison.
